source_processing: Gene expression profiling was performed using 10x Genomics 3’ v3 chemistry and sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq X platform, targeting ~10,000 cells per sample. The BCL Convert (Illumina) software suite was used to process base calls into FASTQ files

Supplementary files format and content: Processed data consist of cell-level gene expression matrices generated from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data. Raw sequencing reads were processed using the 10x Genomics Cell Ranger pipeline to produce filtered feature-barcode matrices for each sample.  Processed files are provided in Hierarchical Data Format (HDF5; .h5) files generated by Cell Ranger. Each .h5 file contains the filtered gene expression matrix, including unique molecular identifier (UMI) counts for each gene in each cell, along with associated cell barcode and feature annotation information.  Each processed dataset corresponds to an individual biological sample and includes all cells and genes passing quality control filtering. The data represent raw UMI counts suitable for downstream analyses such as clustering, differential expression, trajectory inference, and cell-cell communication modeling.

Clinical and research data collection were entered into a web-based electronic case report form created on the REDCap™ platform managed by the University of Florida Clinical and Translational Science Institute. Maternal demographics, indications for delivery, and postnatal data (including demographics) were collected and are outlined in Table 1 and Table S1. Following sample collection, the PBMC was enriched by density centrifugation (Ficoll-PaqueTM PLUS, Cytiva, USA) within 3 hours of blood collection.

Library preparation and sequencing. Fresh PBMC suspensions were filtered with a 30-micron MACS® SmartStrainers (Miltenyi Biotec) and resuspended in PBS containing 0.04% bovine serum albumin. After cell counting, samples were adjusted to 1,000 cells/µl and loaded onto the Chromium chips following the 10X Genomics protocol for single-cell 3’ kits, version 3 (10X Genomics, USA).
data_processing: Gene expression profiling was performed using 10x Genomics 3’ v3 chemistry and sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq X platform, targeting ~10,000 cells per sample. The BCL Convert (Illumina) software suite was used to process base calls into FASTQ files
Assembly: hg38

Supplementary files format and content: Processed data consist of cell-level gene expression matrices generated from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data. Raw sequencing reads were processed using the 10x Genomics Cell Ranger pipeline to produce filtered feature-barcode matrices for each sample.  Processed files are provided in Hierarchical Data Format (HDF5; .h5) files generated by Cell Ranger. Each .h5 file contains the filtered gene expression matrix, including unique molecular identifier (UMI) counts for each gene in each cell, along with associated cell barcode and feature annotation information.  Each processed dataset corresponds to an individual biological sample and includes all cells and genes passing quality control filtering. The data represent raw UMI counts suitable for downstream analyses such as clustering, differential expression, trajectory inference, and cell-cell communication modeling.
